author: PattyKak
body:
Hello Avicus,

I was banned on avicus 4 months ago for "Hacking - Anti Knockback". I was actually never hacking. I want to tell you that I live in Australia and have very bad ping so thats why you may of accused me. I think I should be unbanned because I did nothing wrong.

title: My Appeal

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

Since I cannot find any evidence of you hacking, and you have served a significant amount of time banned, I am going to give you a second chance. Please read the rules before going onto the server again.
Welcome back!

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
